title: French Lamb Kebab aux Herbes
description: A simple yet flavorful kebab dish from France, featuring lamb and herbs, served with a side of garlic bread.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Rub the mixture onto the lamb and Syrian kebabs.
Thread the lamb and kebabs onto the skewers, leaving space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches 145°F (63°C).
While the kebabs are cooking, mix together the rosemary and thyme in a small bowl.
Once the kebabs are cooked, brush with the herb mixture and serve immediately.
